SFObject.title: SFObject
SFObject.description: he Salesforce object type of the record currently displayed on the screen (for example: Account, Visit). This value comes from the UI context and should not be inferred from the user’s question.

filterText.title: filterText
filterText.description: The filterText must represent a value that uniquely or meaningfully identifies a specific record of the referenced object. Leave this field empty if: - The user refers to the current record using contextual expressions like “this”, “this company”, “this visit”, or “the current record”. - The user is asking about an attribute of the current record (for example: “name of this visit”).

recordId.title: recordId
recordId.description: The Salesforce record ID of the record currently displayed on the screen. This value is provided by the UI context and identifies the specific record the user is viewing.
